title: 三种基本时态的被动

examples.en: The room is cleaned every day.
The room will be cleaned tomorrow.

guess.question: 三句话的“被打扫”形式都不一样，变的是哪个部分？

options.text: 变的是 be 动词（is / was / will be），cleaned 一直不变
options.feedback: 对！被动的时态全部由 be 动词承担，过去分词永远不动。
不对——过去分词三句都一样，始终是 cleaned。
不对——主语三句完全相同。

rule.rule: 被动语态的时态只体现在 be 动词上，过去分词保持不变
rule.formula: 一般现在：am / is / are + done　一般过去：was / were + done　一般将来：will be + done

anchors.en: The room is cleaned every day.
The room will be cleaned tomorrow.

trap.wrong: The room will been cleaned tomorrow.
trap.right: The room will be cleaned tomorrow.
trap.why: will 后面一律接 be 的原形，不能写成 been 或 is。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住：过去分词不动，时态全看 be 怎么变。

check.explanation: 上周被举办，用过去时被动 was held。

check.stem: A new hospital ____ (build) here next year.
check.explanation: 明年将被建成，用 will be built。

options.text: The work will be finished tomorrow.
The work will been finished tomorrow.
options.distractor: will 后要接 be 原形

options.text: The work will is finished tomorrow.

check.explanation: 将来时被动：will be + 过去分词。
